Rudo is the foster son of [Regto](https://anilist.co/character/266437/Regto). 

He was originally from the slums of the Sphere, but ended up sentenced to the Abyss after being falsely accused of murder. Due to being physically abused and abandoned by his real parents, Rudo is emotionally closed off and introverted and has permanent painful scars on his hands; having to keep them covered up by bandages and a pair of gloves Regto gifted to him to help sooth the excruciating pain.

Alha is the boss of the Cleaners. He is strong, reliable and trustworthy, with strong characters like [Engine](https://anilist.co/character/266438/Enjin) even acknowledging his leadership. He also is charismatic and has the peoples best intentions at heart, welcoming [Rudo](https://anilist.co/character/266433/Rudo) immediately into the Cleaners because of his faith in his companions.

Alice Stilza is a famous doctor that took part in the treatment for body contamination since the very beginning, but while she was researching contaminated material for the treatment, she took one in without realizing it, causing her voice and her appearence to be weird.

Stilza is very old, with no hair left on her head. The skin on her face is sagging to the point her skull bones are poking out. She is missing several teeth and has a large nose and ear piecing's.

__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

Amo is a teenage girl who lives in the Forbidden Zone Penta. She is able to breath in the Abyss and has seen someone who can go up to Heaven. Whilst appearing sweet and almost childlike, she is easily made emotional and will lash out at others if provoked.

Amo's vital instrument is a pair of watchmen series boots, which when worn together, can produce a 'smell'. Using her jinki, she's able to manipulate the smell and give all who breath it in hallucinations of people they treasure and thus turning them on their allies.
The mother of Amo Empool who sold her to a trafficker.

Cthoni is a rather short, androgynous girl. She is constantly emotionless, often showing little to no expression. She is very quiet and doesn't speak up, which gives her the effect of being unnoticed and being able to sneak up on people. She is realistic in battles, as while [Jabber](https://anilist.co/character/298953/Wonger-Jabber) yearns to continue an unbeatable fight, she knowns it's right to retreat. Cthoni is incredibly strong, being able to pick up Jabber who is many times her size with ease.

Using her jinki, which is a sewer manhole, Cthoni is able to teleport from one place to another quickly and quietly without notice. The manhole is able to fit one person at a time and can vanish when covered again.

__Affiliation:__ Cleaners
__Jinki:__ "Thirst Quencher"

Delmon is a loud and passionate man, always shouting at the top of his lungs. In his past, Delmon worked as a farmer. He knew a woman whos dream it was to see a flower bloom, even in the dead Abyss. Delmon worked tirelessly, eventually cultivating his jinki, out of his desire to make said plants 'grow big'. He eventually did produce a flower and showed it to the woman, who was joyous to see one. Delmon made it his goal to fill the house with flowers. One day, Delmon's farm was attacked by Vandals, leaving a deep mental scar.

Delmon's jinki is a water hose. This grew from his desire to make plants 'grow big'. Much like real water hose's, Delmon's jinki has several different nozzles, which can change the power of the jinki.

Remlin, given for their age, is very childish, as they get excited easily and is very loud. They can typically been seen rushing to things, which sometimes leads to them crashing into people. Remlin is a natural Giver, and was immediately able to use the succession jinki's power upon receiving it. Using their jinki, Remlin is able to create charms for many purposes, such as protection of individuals or huge light shows.
